comments:
bca39a19: ;
 .;Sets initial variables for the DGJOTPUL routine.
 .;DGJTNODE is set to the 0 node of the VAS(393) record
 .;DGJTPAR is set to the '6^7^8' nodes of the DG(40.8) record
 .;DGJTNODT is set to the 'DT' node of the VAS(393) record
 .;DGJTNOW is set to the current date/time
 .;DGJTDL is used to store the number of days late
3c833e84: ;Set DGJTPAR to the 6^7^8 piece of the DG(40.8) record
fef34871: ;Set DGJTNODT to the 'DT' node of the VAS(393) record

caab9f97: ;Set DGJTNOW to the current date/time
;Set DGJTDL to 0

6c7ccfec: ;Check if the status is in DGJTSTAT
;If so, set DGJTREC to 1 and call the PROC routine
f4baee1d: ;Quit the routine

368a604f: ;
 .;If the status is INCOMPLETE:
 .;Set DGJTFLAG based on the due date (in DGJTPAR)
 .;If late, set DGJTDL to the number of days late
 .;Call DAYS and TOT1 routines

20b4aa95: ;
 .;If the status is DICTATED:
 .;Set DGJTFLAG to 1
 .;Call DAYS and TOT1 routines

4d735e7f: ;
 .;If the status is TRANSCRIBED:
 .;Set DGJTFLAG based on the due date (in DGJTPAR)
 .;If late, call DAYS and TOT1 routines

052ce069: ;
 .;If the DG(40.8) record has a non-zero piece 3:
 .;If the status is SIGNED:
 .;Set DGJTFLAG based on the due date (in DGJTPAR)
 .;If late, call DAYS and TOT1 routines
96626cb7: Quit if there are no patient visits to process.
a53db662: Set DGJTDL to the day portion of DGJTNOW (current date/time).

d1ecaa78: Set DGJTFLLG=0 to indicate that no patient visits have been processed yet. Set X1 to the latest of: DGJTNODT (date/time of last patient visit processed), DGJTNOW (current date/time), or the discharge date/time from DGJTNODE (patient info node). Convert X1 to FileMan date/time format.

93dfb691: If DGJTNODT is defined but has no date/time component (first piece), and a patient movement indicator is present (5th piece), then set DGJT2PC and DGJT3PC to '-' (indicating no patient visit data for that day), call COD (unknown routine), set X1 to DGJTNOW or discharge date/time if available, convert to FileMan format, call SET (unknown routine), and quit.
71f6de36: Increment DGJDICTO by the numeric value in X (presumably the length of the patient visit in days). Set DGJT2PC to the value in X followed by '*' (to indicate a patient visit was processed).
a694080a: ;Calculate remaining tour time and format time strings
f5f43f20: ;Call COD subroutine if end date/time is set
ee1e7fd5: ;Calculate actual remaining tour time if end date/time is set
fb4b18dc: ;Exit routine
db7bbb90: ;Get provider name from file entries based on code in DGJTNODE
90d2190a: ;Set flag if no provider name found
5a8d5039: ;Exit COD subroutine
294e4a1b: ;Update provider name and remaining tour time output variables
